csv_scope_of_work: The City of Folsom is requesting proposals from qualified consultants to prepare its 7th Cycle Housing Element Update for the 2029 2037 planning period. The chosen consultant must demonstrate strong expertise in state Housing Element requirements, experience with long-range planning, and an understanding of Folsom s planning framework. The final Housing Element must comply with all state laws, align with the City s General Plan, and obtain certification from California s Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD). Consultants may include subconsultants to ensure they can fulfill all required services.
